authorityRules: This file is the machine-readable archetype SSOT.
Phase artifacts are audit/history inputs, not runtime authorities.
Exact canonical references outrank semantic metadata tags.
Archetype taxonomy is organizational and does not imply mechanical inheritance.
Every specialization has zero or one canonical parent.
Backgrounds are optional route optimizers and never required for archetype validity.
Species mechanics are upstream capability context and do not make generic archetypes species-locked.
Force techniques and Force secrets are enhancement annotations, not primary archetype identity signals.
Narrative-only identity states carry zero mechanical score unless represented by an actual rules element.
